source: Mord Hive v0.5, Scenarios (pp.106-113). The nine core-book missions and the 2D6 Scenario Table (p.105). Each scenario grants the universal +1 Survives plus the awards listed; refined-diamantine amounts and terrain/deployment detail live in the book and the post-battle Income step. universalAward.label: Survives
universalAward.note: If a Hero or Henchman group survives the battle they gain +1 Experience.

rollTable.note: The player with the lower warband rating may choose which scenario is played.
The player with the lower warband rating may choose which scenario is played.

scenarios.name: Defend the Find
scenarios.summary: A warband finds a hab-block full of diamantine, only to be challenged by a rival. The objective is the central building; the smaller warband defends it, the other attacks.

awards.label: Winning Leader
awards.note: The leader of the winning warband gains +1 extra Experience.

awards.label: Per Enemy Out of Action
awards.note: Any Hero earns +1 Experience for each enemy he puts out of action.

awards.label: Refined Diamantine
awards.note: One shard of refined diamantine per Hero (see the book / Income step).

scenarios.name: Skirmish
scenarios.summary: A straightforward clash over scattered shards of diamantine (D3+1 counters). Warriors carrying a counter at the end score extra.

awards.label: Winning Leader
awards.note: The leader of the winning warband gains +1 extra Experience.

awards.label: Per Diamantine Counter
awards.note: A warrior carrying a diamantine counter at the end of the battle receives +1 Experience.

awards.label: Per Enemy Out of Action
awards.note: Any Hero earns +1 Experience for each enemy he puts out of action.
